events.title: Enrollment Info Session
events.description: SPS Enrollment Information Session (In-Person). Enrollment Community Information Sessions. Community information sessions hosted by the SPS Enrollment Team. In-person and virtual sessions are scheduled in November, December, and January, so you can pick what works best for you. Location: Viewlands Elementary, 10525 3rd Ave. NW, Seattle, WA 98177. Here’s what you’ll learn: - How the enrollment process works. - The Open Enrollment for School Choice lottery timeline. - Understanding Open Enrollment for School Choice options and eligibility. There will be 5 in-person and 2 virtual sessions to make it easy for every family to participate. Don’t miss out—let’s make Open Enrollment for School Choice simple and stress-free! Learn more about the Enrollment Information Sessions. (https://www.seattleschools.org/news/enrollment-info-sessions/).
